import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # body_mass_g stored as text -> numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # drop out-of-range body mass (allowed max 6500 g; 3650000 is an error)
    df = df[df['body_mass_g'].between(2500, 6500)]
    # sex missing means unknown; do not guess -> drop
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex'])
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = {}
    grouped = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    for sex, val in grouped.items():
        result[sex] = round(float(val), 2)
    return result
